features.name: Contract Drift Guards
features.description: Review of main 4b65696 on route contracts (the routes agree; drift protection has gaps): (1) the session refresh in base-api.ts builds main/init and GET by hand next to mainContracts.init; (2) callApi always makes query optional, so a contract with a required query key compiles without it; (3) backend path params are Record<string, string>, so renaming :subscriptionId in a contract does not break the controller; (4) the schema registry overwrites a duplicate <method> <path> and the group spread allows collisions, and the completeness test uses a Set; (5) the frontend ESLint rule catches baseApi.http/upload only by name, not a renamed import or a hand-written fetch.
